scope: Seven non-parametrised DOCX template-analysis declarations: five direct analyzer calls and two unified office-template analyze calls, represented by six distinct scenarios. Source review only; no Python binding or execution credit.

testHelpers.use: test-local DOCX builder; not a separate test declaration

targetedFamily.boundary: A file-wide or total-suite denominator was not inferred from an older staging catalogue. Other SOW parser and copy tests are separate operations; PPTX template analysis/copy tests are not Word analysis. Source-only declaration inventory, not pytest execution.

verifiedAspects: The saved SOW template is passed to the direct analyzer; the native assertion accepts either absence of an error member or a dictionary response, including an error dictionary.
gaps: The shared planned scenario requires both a dictionary and no error member, stronger than the native OR assertion. The native test accepts a non-dictionary without an error member and a dictionary containing an error; it cannot verify this successful-response contract.
No analysis fields, classification, table policy or byte-preservation outcome is asserted.

verifiedAspects: Saved template with boilerplate and two placeholders is passed to the direct analyzer; result is asserted to be a dictionary.
gaps: An error dictionary satisfies the native assertion.
Placeholder/boilerplate detection, exact classification and document-byte preservation are not asserted.

verifiedAspects: A saved Word document with heading, blue guidance run, standard text and placeholder is analyzed; response is a dictionary.
gaps: Blue-run detection, guidance classification and individual response fields are not asserted.
An error dictionary satisfies the native assertion.

verifiedAspects: The same saved Word document setup (heading, blue guidance run, standard text and placeholder) is analyzed; response is a dictionary. This native declaration shares one canonical scenario with the other colour test.
gaps: Blue-run detection, guidance classification and individual response fields are not asserted.
An error dictionary satisfies the native assertion.

verifiedAspects: A saved document with one Simple text paragraph is analyzed; response is a dictionary.
gaps: The document is not empty, despite the native test name.
An error dictionary satisfies the native assertion; empty summary counts and input preservation are not asserted.

verifiedAspects: Unified office_template analyzes a saved Word template with customer placeholder title and the native assertion checks that the response has no error member.
gaps: No template category, metadata-cache state, formatting pattern, byte-preservation or rendering outcome is asserted.
The unified path may attach template metadata, but this test does not inspect it.

verifiedAspects: Two unified analyses of an unchanged saved Word template expose template_metadata: initial cache reason stored, subsequent reason hit and second response's first table purpose staffing.
gaps: No equality of complete first and second analyses, cache provenance across different processes, header/body classification or source-byte preservation is asserted.
The assertion concerns metadata from the SOW parser; it does not validate the direct analyzer's formatting categories.
